fields.DESCRIPTION: Bring home the elegance of Rajasthan with this beautifully handcrafted wooden chowki, adorned with a vibrant peacock design. The rich hand-painted meenakari work in red, green, blue, and gold enhances its royal look, making it perfect for pooja rituals, placing idols, or as a decorative stand. Crafted with sturdy wooden legs and intricate detailing, this chowki blends functionality with timeless artistry. A graceful addition to your home décor and a meaningful gift for festive occasions.
